reasoning: Assign each request one predecessor: either one of k interchangeable company-start slots or an earlier request. Each predecessor slot is used at most once. Since request edges only go forward in time, every complete assignment forms disjoint chronological team routes, with at most k starts and all requests covered. Rectangular minimum-cost assignment therefore minimizes all actual equipment moves without forcing every team to be used or charging return trips. Use raw asymmetric move costs rather than assuming triangle inequalities.
